newsitem.title: JORDAN: Netanyahu to visit Jordan on Wednesday - official.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu to visit Jordan on Wednesday - official.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is expected in Amman next Wednesday for talks with Jordan's King Hussein on Middle East peace and bilateral ties, a Jordanian official said on Saturday.

Netanyahu's visit, the second to Amman since his election victory last May, comes in the wake of an improved political climate after last month's long-delayed Israeli troop redeployment from parts of the West Bank town of Hebron.
It will be the Netanyahu's first meeting with King Hussein since the Jordanian monarch flew to Gaza and Tel Aviv in January to help break a deadlock in the Hebron talks.
Jordan has warmly applauded progress in Israeli-Palestinian talks after the Hebron accord but says more has to be done to move ahead with implementing remaining accords with the Palestinians.
